nodes.text: coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one Coder sub-agent to own one complete read-only Fireship channel catalog session and `Fireship_2025_Digest.pptx`. Obtain one channel list identifier, navigate the returned list identifier sequentially at the maximum supported page size until an empty page or source exhaustion, and preserve Video_ID, full title, published timestamp, integer view count, and duration. Filter locally to January 1 through June 30, 2025 inclusive. For each of the six calendar months, count all candidates and choose the single highest-view video with a stable Video_ID tie-break; report a source-empty month rather than inventing one. Convert duration to minutes once. Create one presentation identifier and exactly seven slides: the exact title plus six chronological month slides, each containing all four required values. Read the deck back and return path, compact six-month table, channel page/row/date/ranking controls, and slide count/content checks.
